issues.description: Animal.messageOnFeed() is specified in the UML/problem statement to return String, but the solution declares it to return FeedResponse. This breaks the specified contract and creates inconsistent subclass implementations in the solution: Goat.messageOnFeed() returns String while Pig/Seal return FeedResponse, so the solution codebase as provided would not compile and contradicts what students are told to implement/print in Farm.
issues.suggestedFix: Choose one return type and apply it consistently across statement/UML/template/solution. To match the assignment text, change solution Animal.messageOnFeed() to `public abstract String messageOnFeed()` and update Pig/Seal to return the specified sound strings, removing FeedResponse usage. If FeedResponse is intended, update the UML/problem statement and ensure all subclasses return FeedResponse (including Goat) and adjust Farm printing accordingly.
